name: Corrosion Protection & Coatings
description: Stripping of factory sound deadener, undercoating and sealer where needed, then re-sealing seams, priming, painting and cavity protection after welding so the race shell does not rust from the inside.

components.name: Sound deadener, insulation and undercoat removal
components.description: Removal of factory asphaltic deadener pads, spray-on sound damping, foam baffles and underbody coating in the cockpit, trunk and areas to be welded. Saves weight (typically tens of pounds on a modern coupe) and exposes seams for stitch welding and cage plates.
components.location: Cockpit floor, tunnel, dash panel, trunk, wheelhouses.

factory.name: GM asphaltic/mastic deadener and spray-on damping

raceOptions.name: Dry-ice blasting or heat gun + scraper
raceOptions.notes: Dry ice shatters deadener without damaging e-coat. Avoid aggressive blasting of e-coat outside weld zones.

installNotes: Wear respirator; old coatings may contain hazardous compounds.
Clean residue with wax & grease remover before welding/painting.

components.name: Seam sealer
components.description: Flexible sealer applied over all stitch-welded and disturbed seams after priming to keep water and fumes out and to stop crevice corrosion.
components.location: All welded seams: towers, floor/rocker, tunnel, rear rails, trunk.

raceOptions.name: 1K or 2K urethane/epoxy seam sealer
raceOptions.notes: Apply over epoxy primer, then topcoat.

fluids.name: Seam sealer
fluids.capacity: approx 4-6 cartridges for a full shell

installNotes: Apply after epoxy primer, before topcoat.
inspection: Check for cracked sealer at towers (indicates seam movement).

components.name: Epoxy primer and chassis paint (cockpit, bay, underbody)
components.description: Epoxy primer over all bare/welded metal followed by a durable topcoat (cockpit often painted light grey/white so leaks and cracks are easy to see). Use weld-through primer on mating faces before welding plates.
components.location: Entire shell interior, engine bay and underbody.

raceOptions.name: 2K epoxy primer + 2K urethane topcoat
raceOptions.notes: Light colour in cockpit aids inspection.

installNotes: Mask datum holes, captured nut threads, rivnut threads and ground studs before paint.
Leave bare-metal ground pads for electrical grounds (see electrical.grounding).
inspection: Touch up chips on underside after each event.

components.name: Cavity wax / internal rust proofing
components.description: Penetrating wax sprayed into rails, rockers and pillars after welding (welding burns off internal factory e-coat). Apply after paint, with long-wand nozzles through existing access holes.
components.location: Inside rockers, front and rear rails, pillars.

raceOptions.name: Cavity wax
raceOptions.brand: 3M Cavity Wax Plus, Eastwood Internal Frame Coating, Bilt Hamber Dynax

installNotes: Apply after all welding, before installing harnesses/lines in those cavities.

components.name: Underbody stone-chip coating
components.description: Thin, light stone-chip coating on wheelhouses and lower underbody (not heavy rubberized undercoat) to protect paint from track debris while keeping weight down.
components.location: Wheelhouses, rocker undersides, front of floor.

raceOptions.name: Paintable chip guard / raptor-type liner (thin coat)

installNotes: Mask lift points, datum holes and all threaded holes.
